title: EventBus duplicate register during delivery contract

contract.duplicate_register: Registering an already registered plugin and callback during delivery succeeds without creating a duplicate listener entry
contract.idempotent_registration: Repeated registration of the same plugin and callback is idempotent
contract.current_event_continuity: The active event continues successfully after duplicate registration
contract.delivery_order: The existing listener chain remains stable after duplicate registration
contract.duplicate_prevention: The listener registry retains exactly one entry for the plugin and callback
contract.subsequent_delivery: The existing listener continues receiving subsequent events normally
contract.registry_stability: Duplicate registration during emit does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after duplicate registration
contract.permission_enforcement: Register and emit operations require the events permission
